Exceptional Detached Family Residence on c. 0.6 Acres – Prime Countryside Setting Close to Doon Village
MRA Auctioneers are delighted to present this impressive detached family residence, ideally positioned on a beautifully maintained site extending to approximately 0.6 acres, just 2km from Doon Village, Co. Limerick.
Constructed in 2007, this spacious home enjoys stunning panoramic views of the surrounding countryside while offering the perfect balance of peaceful rural living and convenient access to village amenities. Doon is a thriving and welcoming community with an excellent range of facilities including primary and secondary schools, local shops, churches, GAA facilities, scenic lakes, rivers, woodland walks and numerous outdoor recreational activities. Limerick City and its surrounding suburbs are also within an easy commuting distance.
Approached through electric entrance gates, the property offers excellent privacy and ample parking, complemented by a detached garage and generous landscaped gardens.
The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed to suit modern family living and extends over two floors. The ground floor comprises a bright entrance hall, lrge sitting room, spacious kitchen/dining area, living room, conservatory, utility room, 5th bedroom with shower ensuite.
Upstairs, the property offers four generous double bedrooms, master bedroom en-suite bathroom, together with a well-appointed family bathroom.


This is an outstanding opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in one of East Limerick’s most desirable rural locations. Combining generous living accommodation, a private setting and excellent accessibility, this superb property is sure to appeal to families, those seeking additional space, or anyone looking to enjoy the best of countryside living without compromising on convenience.
Early viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment through MRA Auctioneers.
